function: Excluded: the DNN actor only outputs semantic extraction factors and synchronization (upload or drop) indicators, an edge-computing decision; power and CPU frequencies come from convex optimization (pp. 7-9).
notes: above_phy. p. 7: "the DNN model outputs the extraction factors first, which can be later quantized into some potential synchronization solutions"; the learned decision is the upload-or-drop indicator and extraction factor. Transmit power and CPU frequencies come from the model-based critic, p. 8: "As shown in P2.2, it is a convex optimization problem" and p. 9: "the stationary point can be obtained by a bi-section search approach", so no physical-layer decision is learned. The semantic encoders and decoders are pretrained tiny models taken as given, p. 10: "The tiny-ML-based encoders and decoder are pretrained in the core cloud", not learned or designed here. The title on page 1 matches the DOI.
